source: IMCCE (Observatoire de Paris), Phenomena of the Galilean satellites, files phenE.2026 and phenE.2027 from https://ftp.imcce.fr/pub/ephem/satel/phenjupiter/ (authors V. Lainey, M. Gastineau, J. Nepper), downloaded 2026-11-19
convention: Terrestrial Time (TT = UTC + 69.184 s). The moment the satellite or its umbra is bisected by Jupiter’s limb, as seen from the Earth. SHI/SHE = shadow ingress/egress, TRI/TRE = transit ingress/egress; I II III IV = Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto. Only the shadow and transit records are kept (eclipses and occultations are not predicted by skyEvents.ts).
